content.short: QTON is a quest-based TON onboarding app that teaches Web3 concepts through tasks and rewards.
content.description: QTON is an onboarding app built for the TON ecosystem. TON App and Tongram listings describe an interactive quest experience that introduces Web2 users to Web3, awards XP for completing tasks, and can qualify participants for airdrops or other rewards. It is best categorized as a launch and growth tool for bringing new users into TON projects. QTON is included because it helps the TON ecosystem with launch, discovery, fundraising, distribution, or early project visibility. QTON is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
